notes: Definition 1.0.0 of the large_model_value_v0 strategy (#1235), confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-12. The tier is unchanged: capital-adjusted gross profit per employee, (gross_profit - total_assets*risk_free_rate)/headcount, with cuts at 1,000,000 and 3,000,000 (lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive). The valuation basis changes from P/S to P/GP = market value / gross profit, where market value is shares outstanding times the last unadjusted close and gross profit is the same latest-complete-fiscal-year gross_profit input that the labor-efficiency numerator uses. Band derivation (vision.md P/S anchors divided by a reference gross margin, 2dp half-even): traditional 3/0.40 = 7.50 and 4/0.40 = 10.00; tech 8/0.70 = 11.4286 -> 11.43 and 10/0.70 = 14.2857 -> 14.29; large_model_native 20/0.75 = 26.6667 -> 26.67 and 30/0.75 = 40.00. P/GP removes the gross-margin effect, so the former hidden 0.35 gross-margin gate is deleted. Every tier is eligible. Gap = target P/GP midpoint / current P/GP - 1; a current P/GP above the band upper bound is rejected_valuation_above_tier_band; candidates rank by descending gap, tie-break ascending issuer id, top 2, equal weight. P/S is still computed and recorded. The golden decisions reuse the grounded inputs of definition 0.1.0. Their expected values were computed by a plain Decimal calculation that does not call the evaluator; libs/contracts/tests/test_strategy_v1.py recomputes them the same way, and libs/factors/tests/test_strategy_evaluator.py proves the evaluator agrees.
